entities.summary: Namangan State University (NamSU) was established in 1942 as a pedagogical institute. It is in Namangan province which has almost 2.8 mln population with 7900 km2 area located in eastern part on Uzbekistan, considered one of the strategically important area. Nowadays NamSU has over 28,547 students in bachelor's and master's degree programs. NamSU has 600 teaching staff which 46% of them have PhD and doctoral levels degrees. NamSU offers various courses of study, including 54 bachelor educational programs, 15 master's specialization programs, 10 programs for full-time doctorate and another 15 programs for part-time doctorate.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Namangan State University has played a significant role in shaping the educational landscape of Uzbekistan since its establishment in 1942. With over 28,547 students enrolled in various degree programs, it serves as a vital institution for regional human resource development.
